instruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de envelope
prompt:
Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring an elegant luxury envelope as the main subject, positioned in the foreground and occupying a strong central presence in the frame. The envelope is handcrafted, premium and refined, with realistic paper texture in soft matte cream, subtle fibers, delicate terracotta accents and sophisticated golden details. Elegant folds, precise geometry and tactile finishing give it a high-end invitation feel. Include a finely detailed wax seal, embossed emblem or ornamental closure in gold, adding richness and craftsmanship.

The envelope is placed within a luxurious, story-driven environment, not a flat backdrop. The background forms an elegant narrative scene with softly blurred but recognizable elements, such as a refined classical interior, a tasteful floral arrangement, warm decorative architecture or a sophisticated evening setting. The scene should feel premium, calm and graceful, with depth and context while keeping the envelope as the clear hero.

Surrounding elements are carefully curated and symbolic, including subtle flowers, petals, delicate leaves, soft sparkles or floating dust particles, arranged organically around the envelope. These elements should feel natural and minimal, enhancing elegance and visual harmony without overpowering the composition.

Lighting is cinematic and refined, with a soft key light illuminating the envelope, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and gentle volumetric light rays adding depth and atmosphere. Subtle haze, atmospheric glow and floating particles catch the light, creating a dreamy, sophisticated and luxurious mood. Shadows are soft, realistic and directional.

The color palette is intentional and harmonious, based on terracotta, cream and gold, with warm gradients, luminous highlights and controlled contrast. The terracotta adds warmth and richness, the cream provides softness and elegance, and the gold brings prestige and refinement.

Composition: foreground-focused, envelope sharply in focus, background softly defocused, strong sense of depth and perspective. Camera: macro lens look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on envelope texture, seal and ornaments, cinematic bokeh in background lights. Style: photorealistic, hyper-detailed, cinematic realism, elegant, premium invitation aesthetic. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, luxurious, visually enchanting, suitable for elegant invitation visuals.
folhaInstruction: Gere um prompt para seedream para criar uma imagem de de uma folha em branco com adornos em torno, sendo essa folha o objeto central e principal da imagem, ocupando quase a tela toda, mas ainda deixando espaço para visualizar o chão, o fundo e os elementos laterais
folhaPrompt: Ultra-detailed, hyper-realistic cinematic composition featuring a blank elegant sheet of paper as the main subject, positioned centrally and occupying almost the entire frame while still leaving visible space around the edges to reveal the floor, background, and lateral elements. The paper feels premium, handcrafted and refined, with realistic texture (soft matte surface, subtle fibers, slight pearlescent or warm paper grain), crisp clean edges, delicate folds if any, and a luxurious editorial finish. The sheet is the clear hero of the scene, large and dominant, but not completely isolated — it is integrated into a sophisticated environment that remains visible around it. Surrounding the paper are tasteful ornamental details arranged with balance and restraint: delicate floral accents, elegant stems, subtle gilded ornaments, fine decorative flourishes, soft draped fabric, and refined particles or small embellishments, all placed organically around the composition without overcrowding it. The floor and background remain visible to provide depth and context, creating a rich, story-driven setting rather than a flat backdrop. The environment is elegant and atmospheric, with a warm luxurious ambiance, softly blurred but still recognizable, featuring refined architectural hints, tasteful decorative surfaces, or a premium interior aesthetic. Lighting is cinematic and graceful, with soft key light illuminating the blank sheet, delicate rim light outlining its edges, and subtle volumetric glow enhancing the ornaments. Gentle shadows are realistic and directional, while atmospheric haze adds depth and sophistication. The color palette is harmonious and intentional, inspired by luxury stationery and elegant editorial design — terracotta, cream, and gold — with smooth tonal transitions, warm highlights, and controlled contrast. Composition: foreground-dominant, blank sheet sharply in focus, ornaments framing the subject, visible floor and background, strong sense of depth and balance. Camera: high-end editorial photography look, shallow depth of field, crisp focus on paper texture and ornamental details, soft cinematic bokeh in the background. Style: photorealistic, ultra-detailed, cinematic elegance, premium, refined, minimalist luxury. Technical details: 8K ultra-high resolution, realistic materials, global illumination, volumetric lighting, high dynamic range. Aspect ratio: 9:16. Rendering quality: editorial-grade, sophisticated, visually polished, suitable for elegant stationery, invitations and luxury branding visuals.
cartaoPrompt: Gere um cartão na horizontal elegante nessa mesma atmosfera e mesmo tema (Elegante) e mesma paleta de cor (Terracota, creme e dourado), escrito apenas Lívia Almeida, idade 60 Anos.
aberturaInstruction: Crie um prompt de geração de vídeo para essa imagem com a abertura do envelope e um brilho saindo de dentro, no final o brilho vai fazer a tela ficar toda em branco sólido ao aumentar o brilho.
aberturaPrompt:
A animação começa focando em um envelope fechado com um único selo de cera. Assim que o selo de cera se desprende fisicamente e cai no chão, ele não é substituído, duplicado nem regenerado em momento algum. O envelope permanece permanentemente aberto após esse instante, sem que surja qualquer outro selo.
Uma vez removido o selo, a aba do envelope se levanta lentamente. De seu interior, emergem brilhos cintilantes, poeira brilhante e rastros de luz radiante, espalhando-se pelo ambiente em um espetáculo hipnotizante, com feixes mágicos de partículas luminosas que se curvam em torno do envelope, passando à sua frente e por trás em um movimento contínuo. Essas partículas originam-se apenas de dentro do envelope, aumentando em densidade e luminosidade à medida que se deslocam.
A luz radiante se intensifica e se expande para fora, preenchendo gradualmente toda a cena. Nenhum novo objeto físico é introduzido durante essa transição. O brilho intenso dos feixes e das partículas transforma-se em uma tela branca sólida e deslumbrante no quadro final. A câmera aplica um zoom sutil e lento.
